description: Defines strong type templates and associated operator overloads for type safety and arithmetic operations within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: strong_type
classes.description: Template class for creating strongly-typed arithmetic types with optional properties.

classes.name: strong_equality::strong_property
classes.description: Defines equality operators for strong types.

classes.name: strong_equality_with
classes.description: Template for adding equality operators between a type and multiple arithmetic types.

classes.name: strong_multiplication_with
classes.description: Template for adding multiplication operators between a type and multiple arithmetic types.

classes.name: strong_comparison::strong_property
classes.description: Defines comparison operators for strong types.

classes.name: strong_increment_decrement::strong_property
classes.description: Defines increment and decrement operators for strong types.

classes.name: strong_arithmetic::strong_property
classes.description: Defines arithmetic operators (+, -, *, /) for strong types.

classes.name: strong_arithmetic_with_underlying_type::strong_property
classes.description: Defines arithmetic operators with underlying type for strong types.

classes.name: strong_bitwise::strong_property
classes.description: Defines bitwise operators (&, |, ^, <<, >>) for strong types.

classes.name: strong_conversion_to::strong_property
classes.description: Defines conversion operators to other types for strong types.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Accessor for the underlying value of the strong type.
